name: Disciple
summary: The open door of the sect. Everyone who is sworn and holds no office sits here in all but name, and it recognises nothing at all, because recognition begins where office begins.

name: The Ironpact
summary: A guild-house that sells capacity: members are the muscle it rents out to whoever is paying, and it keeps a roster of names whose labour is worth more than any individual contract. It publishes a stipend, quarters and a share of contract income in exchange for standing orders — a member answers when called. It rivals the Saltledger over the harbour tariffs and answers the Quiet House at every coronation it can reach. (full text in lore/prose/clans/the_ironpact.md)

name: The Quiet House
summary: A lineage that has spent four generations buying its way out of the ledger. It publishes teaching — technique, attendance, and a chamber to practise in — and takes discretion in return: what is done inside the house is not written down and not repeated. It rivals the Saltledger over who may keep a record, because a house that files everything is a house that cannot be left alone. (full text in lore/prose/clans/the_quiet_house.md)

name: The Saltledger
summary: A counting house that has decided access is the only thing worth fighting over. Members trade on every road the house holds, and the house answers that access with a ledger: who may use the roads, at what rate, on whose word. It publishes credit, safe-conduct and trading posts against exclusivity — a member who will not carry a rival's goods. It rivals the Ironpact over the harbour tariffs, because one of them writes the contract and the other decides what it is worth.

name: Ward
summary: Every sworn member of the Iron Vine who holds no office is a Ward. It is the unbounded office of the house, and it recognises no stat at all, because what the Vine hands out is load and not edge.

name: The Watchgate
summary: The brokers who sell standing at the Cairn Field, on the ground that no tier in the setting can produce a practitioner of its own. It exists because a tier with no local cultivators and no export is sustained entirely by spectators, so gate fees are the only tax the plains can actually collect.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to turn an audience into the only currency the mortal plains can levy
attributes.what_it_spends: iron. The ring's seating is built from the same ore as everything else on the tier, so every place sold is iron cut away from a claim somebody else is holding, and the gate's real cost is a mining decision it makes on somebody's behalf
attributes.what_it_keeps: a list of places, not a list of names: the seats are resold continuously, so the gate holds no record of who has watched and only a record of who has paid
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: they take the buyers' names with them and nothing else. The places are sold again inside a season and the gate does not pursue, because a gate that can identify a former broker can be asked what the former broker knows
attributes.who_pays_it: the villages, out of the ring's take, because the ring is the only thing anybody walks a long way to
attributes.why_it_can_charge: the trials on the ring are the only thing below the Spirit Peaks that somebody from a higher tier will pay to see, and they arrive through a stair that is one-way
attributes.its_standing_conflict: with the office that certifies the trials: the gate controls who is in the ring and the office controls who may be judged in it, and neither can do the other's job

name: The Quarrywright
summary: The guild that works the Ironhead Flats and sells the tier's only dense material. It exists because ore is the one thing on the plains a core can be caged in, and because the work at the face needs a realm the tier does not license, so every body it employs is a visitor.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to cut and sell the only material in the mortal tier dense enough to hold a forming core
attributes.what_it_spends: bodies it does not have. Nothing native to this tier is licensed to do the work at the face, so the guild hires practitioners arriving down the stair and pays them at a rate that has nothing to do with what the tier is worth
attributes.what_it_keeps: the seam key, and a working face rather than a claim: holding the face holds the deposit
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: they forfeit the seam key and are marked on the flats as one who left a face unrepaired, which on ground with no deed and no measurable boundary is the only punishment available and is followed for life
attributes.why_it_was_able_to_be_predatory: the flats are only worth holding while the seam is being worked, so every resident is a temporary occupier by construction and has no standing to complain about terms
attributes.its_standing_conflict: with the guild-house that rents out muscle: the pact answers a standing order and this work is urgent, so the guild either buys capacity at a price set by somebody else's roster or loses a shift

name: The Spoilwright
summary: The guild that moves the spoil heap off the seam floor, which is the only remaining ore-costly job on the plains. It exists because spatial law is unspent here, so waste does not disperse: forty years of heap has to be carried out by hand before the working face can advance a foot.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to clear the heap that forty years of cutting left standing on the ore that is gone
attributes.what_it_spends: carts, oxen and hands, none of which the tier has natively: the guild buys bodies the same way the quarry guild does and charges the quarry guild for the privilege
attributes.what_it_keeps: a public tally of heap moved by each crew, kept where the crews can read it - the one piece of accounting this tier can support, because it is a weight and not a distance
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: they owe the heap they did not move. The tally stays up, so a defector's name sits against a number that only goes down, and a crew that will not take the debt hires somebody who has not read it yet
attributes.why_the_two_guilds_cannot_coexist: every barrow the spoilwright removes is a barrow of shift the quarrywright does not pay for, and the face cannot advance until the heap is gone - so the resource and the access to it are permanently in opposition
attributes.the_law_that_causes_it: with no spatial law there is no process on which waste disperses, so a spent seam is visible from outside. That is the setting's clearest evidence that a resource can end, and both guilds are businesses built on reading it

name: The Field Registry
summary: The college that keeps the burnt list: at a settlement funeral the dead are read as the frame said, not as the village remembers. It exists because realm nine was a limit nobody was issued, so the record of a life is also the record of a gate that was never available to it.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to record a life against the ceiling its frame had already spent before the person was born
attributes.what_it_spends: a reader's time and the cost of the plate it is read from. It keeps no second copy: the list exists once, in one reader's head until the reading, and a second copy would be a second opinion
attributes.what_it_keeps: the divergence between the frame's reading and the village's memory, which the culture permits to differ and the college records rather than resolves
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: the office cannot be resigned, only walked. Whoever walks is entered on the next list by the college itself, and is read as a gate not taken - which is the only judgement this office is able to pass
attributes.why_it_is_a_college_and_not_a_church: nobody here expects to ascend, so the record is not a hope but an audit, and an audit does not require a god to be worth keeping
attributes.its_relation_to_the_ring: the ring publishes what a body did; this office publishes what the frame allowed. The two readings are permitted to disagree and both are kept

name: The Reckoning Seat
summary: The mortal office that certifies a breakthrough at the Cairn Field and is paid out of the gate fees. It exists because the tier licenses no humanoid, so a body cannot be judged by anything of its own kind here - the reading has to be taken by somebody the frame considers an outsider.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to read a body's frame against the tier's ceiling and certify what was attempted
attributes.what_it_spends: nothing but a reading. The office has no budget, no seat of its own and no practitioners, which is precisely why its word is worth a gate fee: it is the only certification this tier can issue and it is issued from outside
attributes.what_it_keeps: the list of what was attempted here and what the frame read, with no note of what was felt
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: a judge who resigns loses the reading permanently. The seat is refilled from the ring's own retired judges, so the office outlives every person in it and no one in it can be threatened by anything except a successor
attributes.why_an_outsider_must_sign: the frame admits no humanoid, so there is nobody on this ground whose own training the reading could appeal to. The certification is trustworthy for the same reason everything else on the plains is custom instead of law
attributes.its_standing_conflict: with the brokers who sell the places: the office decides who may be judged inside the ring and the gate decides who is inside it, and neither can substitute for the other

name: The Dry Salt Company
summary: A counting house that underwrites a caravan against the road closing, which is a risk no market can price because no tier below the spirit frame has a season. It exists because elemental law is unwritten in the mortal tier, so nobody can forecast anything and insurance is the only instrument left for the unknown.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to carry the one risk the plains cannot price: that the stair will not be walkable when a caravan is on it
attributes.what_it_spends: premium taken in advance, in ore or in labour, because a premium paid after the loss is a contribution. The company pays out of nobody's reserve, which is the whole of its capital
attributes.what_it_keeps: the standing of its guarantor, not a register of voyages. A company that could enumerate its losses on this tier could be asked how it knew
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: a departing guarantor is released from the road and given a half-cloak in a grade that opens no door on any licensed house, so leaving costs the only credential the culture has
attributes.why_insurance_is_the_only_answer: with no elemental law there is no seasonal cycle to write a premium against, so the risk cannot be modelled; it can only be pooled, and pooling needs somebody willing to be trusted with other people's caravan
attributes.what_it_actually_sells: not safety. It sells a rate, so that a traveller can decide whether this road is worth walking this year - which on ground where distance is not conserved is the only planning tool available

name: The Jade Writ
summary: The office that collects debts of access rather than money at the one pass that crosses the ridge. It exists because passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person, nobody may levy a seat, and somebody therefore has to decide who is owed the gate.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to keep a written account of who may use the crossing and on whose word, at a place that can physically hold only a few people at once
attributes.what_it_spends: the willingness to be disliked at every crossing. It has no force of its own; it holds a gate by being the office that can close it, and the entire cost of the office is that this is visible to everyone who uses the road
attributes.what_it_keeps: halves. A debt here is marked on a tally cut with the debtor and kept by both parties, so an enforcement that did not honour its own mark could not be enforced against
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: a writ-officer who leaves is given the debt they were carrying, in full and transferred to their own name. They leave owing exactly what they were holding, which is the only exit the office offers and is why none of them take it quickly
attributes.why_it_fails_against_the_unfiled: a people who hold no written record and retire their names annually cannot be cited, so the writ's entire instrument is unavailable to the one population that needs it most. The office's answer is to deny the pass, and that is why the counter-culture exists

name: The Standing Name
summary: A mutual society on the principle that a community's promise is re-made jointly once a year and never priced. It exists because a carrying culture that refused to publish a price list could not buy insurance, so it pooled liability by presence instead - and this is the institution that makes refusing to be a number survivable.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to carry the liability of a trade that will not be measured, by making the promise in public instead
attributes.what_it_spends: the labour of being present once a year, for as long as it takes, in front of the whole community. There is no reserve and no fund: the society's capital is the hours its members spend being seen
attributes.what_it_keeps: no register. An unsettled claim is carried by two people who each hold a share and are not told what the other holds, and it is discharged at the next re-drawing
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: a member's share of any unsettled claim is transferred at the next re-drawing, in front of the community, and cannot be contested afterwards. Leaving is legal, quiet, and final in a way the passage writ's exit is not
attributes.why_it_can_threaten_a_counting_house: a house that publishes credit and safe conduct against exclusivity cannot price a community that will not state what anything is worth, so the house's only lever is to deny the road - which is what made the paperless culture necessary
attributes.what_it_is_not: not a guild of employers and not a family. It has no employers, no lineage and no roster, and the Standing Name is re-cut from scratch each year because a promise that can be inherited quietly is not a promise

name: The Wide Door
summary: A lodge that does not sell houses or passages but bodies already tuned to the frame on the far side of a tear. It exists because a boundary is the edge of a law budget, a body arriving where a required group is unwritten is injured rather than slowed, and so the only scarce thing at a crossing is a person the far side will not reject.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to place a body on the far side of a tear that the far side has agreed to accept
attributes.what_it_spends: bodies held on the near side as cover, and the near side is where they can be seen. The lodge's capital is other people's visibility and it borrows it
attributes.what_it_keeps: nothing. There is no roster and no membership: a name used at the far side stays used, and the lodge is a set of doors rather than an institution
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: nothing happens, and that is the finding. A person used at the far side cannot be dismissed from a thing they were never shown is there, and a body that has been sold across a tear is not a body anybody can recall to this side of it
attributes.why_no_one_can_investigate_it: it keeps no record, publishes no rate and has no address. The only evidence of it is a name that appears at a place where names are read, which is exactly the evidence the lodge is built not to leave
attributes.its_standing_conflict: with the writ that keeps a written account of the crossing and with the house that publishes credit: all three need names to work, and this is the one that has arranged never to need them

name: The Salt Leech
summary: The network that works the tailings on a dormant isle nobody collects from and sells the result as spirit stone. It exists because a severed frame keeps paying upkeep nobody collects, and low-grade jade is worthless on the isle and unmatchable ashore.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to move a residue that has no legal owner from ground that has no legal occupant
attributes.what_it_spends: bodies, and specifically bodies that cannot be identified ashore. The network's labour is recruited from people who are not on anything, which is why its only real expense is keeping people off lists
attributes.what_it_keeps: no fixed ground of its own. The isle is the ground and the charter over it is somebody else's, which is the arrangement that makes the work possible
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: they are left on the isle. Ashore a worker needs a name to be paid, and the network's only asset is that its members have none
attributes.how_it_is_tolerated: the residue is worth nothing while it is on the isle and dangerous once it is ashore, so the charter holder takes a share of the value rather than the material and has no interest in stopping the work
attributes.what_it_buys: tuned bodies. Hauling is not the hard part of moving material off a frame whose readings do not match the parent, and the network buys the tolerance rather than the strength

name: The Bed of Eighteen
summary: The office that holds the abandoned crossing at the immortal border and sells standing on it. It exists because a seat cannot be held by somebody who cannot pay for it every period, and nobody who attempted the crossing could, so the bed is unmortared and anybody with the most upkeep gets it.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to sit on a bed of seats that cost more to hold than the people using them can pay
attributes.what_it_spends: the upkeep, which it cannot afford and passes on in full to whoever is standing there. Its own books show a deficit that grows with every period it stays in the office
attributes.what_it_keeps: the bed itself, which is a physical thing: a stretch of unmortared seats at the border that no institution has ever been able to hold open
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: the keeper leaves owing the upkeep accumulated while they held it, and the bed goes to whoever offers more - so the office has no stability, only a price, and the stability everyone assumes is somebody else's problem
attributes.why_the_border_is_still_one_person_at_a_: because the seats are unmortared, so nobody can hold the whole crossing open; the office sells a place on it, which is not the same thing as holding it
attributes.its_standing_conflict: with the office that names the highest seats and is forbidden to take them: one sells a seat it cannot afford and the other holds a seat it may not take, and both are selling the same scarce thing - standing above the border

name: The Nine Seat Notary
summary: The office that names the unfilled high seats and is forbidden to take them. It exists because four vacant seats were very nearly filled by decree, and the attempt taught this setting to write a vacancy as its own state rather than as a zero.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to give an unoccupied seat an occupant who will not sit in it
attributes.what_it_spends: nothing it can name. It names seats, records trials and holds no ground, which is why its authority survives the arrival of anyone who can afford to buy a place
attributes.what_it_keeps: the three-state vocabulary, which is the entire content of the office: a seat that does not exist, a seat that exists and is vacant, and a seat that exists and is held are three different facts and none of them is zero
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: the office cannot be left, only filled. A notary who resigns has their own name entered in the register as a vacancy, which is why nobody in it resigns and why the office has an unbroken tenure nobody has ever tested
attributes.why_every_appointment_is_a_third_party_t: the office may not take a seat, so it cannot judge its own nominee, and every appointment therefore passes a trial held by somebody with no stake in the outcome
attributes.what_it_observes_from: the second layer, where the four surplus imprints are actually written, because a vacancy is visible from the ground that has the capacity nobody upstairs can buy

name: The Held Hour
summary: The office that tends the floor during the hour nobody is permitted to explain. It exists because the observation of a strained law only counts if it is repeated, and at the top of the setting one repetition costs a lifetime, so the work is done by a very small and very old body.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to hold one reading of one law group long enough for the holding to count as data
attributes.what_it_spends: a lifetime per reading, which is the price of the tier's clock and the reason the college is small and old rather than large and staffed
attributes.what_it_keeps: no instrument log and no account. The floor's sound is the record, and the office's contribution is that it is still sounding
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: the hour is held by whoever is in the room, so a member who leaves during it breaks the holding - and the college records the break as a reading. It is the only failure it has ever recorded
attributes.what_it_is_forbidden_to_do: explain the floor to a visitor. The refusal is the office's central etiquette and the only thing about it anybody outside is permitted to be told
attributes.what_it_does_not_admit: what is underneath. The floor is where the frame's surplus is observed as a strain rather than described as one, and the office that tends it is the only party that has been told where the reading comes from

name: The Ninth Watch
summary: The only standing force on the plains, paid out of the ring's take and posted at the foot of the stair. It exists because the only door out of a world that licenses nobody to enter it fills with unlicensed arrivals, and a queue of bodies is the one thing that must not become a fight.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to keep the queue on the only departure from a world orderly, and to stop it killing anyone
attributes.what_it_spends: the whole of the ring's take, which is the only revenue the tier can actually levy
attributes.what_it_keeps: the order of the queue and nothing else. It has no jurisdiction on the plain, no bead and no standing, because a force with standing would be a second authority on ground that cannot measure one
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: a watchman who leaves forfeits his place at the foot of the stair, and the stair is one-way - spatial law is unspent here, so the return is a walk whose distance cannot be established. There is nowhere on this tier for a deserter to go
attributes.why_it_exists_instead_of_a_militia: the arrivals are the people this tier cannot produce, so the force is paid by the tier and staffed entirely by people it has no right to keep
attributes.its_standing_conflict: with the brokers who sell places at the ring: the watch decides the order arrivals are served in and the gate decides what the order is worth, and both are selling the same visitor twice

name: The Gap School
summary: An academy that teaches by seating a law, diffing what the tier newly permits, and then moving the student somewhere that law is missing. It exists because a spare seat is not capacity for a new path - it is the only condition under which a law can be studied instead of obeyed.

attributes.what_it_is_for: to produce a reading of what a law does by removing it from a body that has it
attributes.what_it_spends: a body per experiment. A student is trained under the full composition, measured, and then taken somewhere a required group is unwritten - where the technique fails at full strength rather than at reduced strength, which is the only measurement that distinguishes a hole from a weakness
attributes.what_it_keeps: the partners of its graduates. A body taken to a frame that lacks a group comes back with a law scar, and the college holds the record of what was missing from which of them
attributes.what_happens_to_members_who_leave: they keep the scar and lose the record. The college owns the account of what was removed; a graduate who stops attending still carries the hole and no longer has anyone who can tell them what shape it is
attributes.why_it_needs_unmeasurable_ground: the method requires a frame that cannot be surveyed, because a frame that reports its own size cannot be shown to have a group missing. The survey culture on the plains is the only people who will agree to work somewhere they cannot map
attributes.what_it_produced: the paperless counter-culture of the people who were sent down and came back: a body whose technique stopped working in a specific place is a body with nothing to prove by returning to it
